atAGlance: Sương sáo is grass jelly, a dark herbal jelly served with syrup, ice, or milk. It is cooling, lightly bitter, and very soft.
whatItIs: Sương sáo is grass jelly, usually cut into cubes or strips and served as a light dessert or drink topping.
howToEnjoy: Eat it cold with syrup or milk. The soft jelly texture is the main event.
howLocalsOrder: Order sương sáo cold with less syrup if you want its herbal grass-jelly bitterness to stay refreshing rather than hidden by sugar.
worthKnowing: Grass jelly sits between drink and dessert in Vietnam, especially on hot days.
goodToKnow: The flavor is herbal rather than fruity. Choose it when you want something cooling and not too rich.
